title: Dispatch review notes
description: review-notes.json, written by a dispatched run beside report.md. It is hunk's agent-context sidecar, version 1 (https://hunk.dev/docs/agents/agent-context-and-stml/), so `hunk diff --agent-context review-notes.json` loads it unchanged. Kit adds the optional top-level head. Unknown fields are allowed, as hunk allows them. Range order (end >= start) is checked by kit and hunk; JSON Schema cannot express it.

version.description: Sidecar format version. Optional; defaults to 1.

head.description: Kit extension: the commit SHA the notes describe. Review runs set it to the head they reviewed.

path.description: The file's current path, or its previous path for a rename.

summary.description: One-line summary of the file's change.

author.description: Card label: run name and model.

markup.description: Experimental STML body; hunk ignores it without --experimental.

source.description: The run that wrote the note.

range.description: 1-based inclusive [start, end] line range; end >= start.
